caption: The drawing depicts a wooden-framed sofa upholstered in a yellow fabric with a repeating pattern of small, brown floral motifs. The sofa has a straight back featuring a carved wood panel along the top, with the center panel displaying a draped ribbon or swag design. The arms of the sofa are curved and slope gently downward, with the wood frame visible along their edges. The seat consists of three separate cushion sections. The sofa stands on six slender, turned wooden legs, each leg equipped with a small caster at the bottom. The drawing has a thin black border and a square inset at the lower left corner, which displays an enlarged version of the floral motif found on the upholstery, rendered in yellow and brown. The background is plain with minimal shadow and line indications for the floor and wall intersections.
title: Sofa
